Globally C2 V; 0<alpha<=beta and genuine evaluated Hessian bounds alpha||a||²<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||² for every x,a.

Observations are globally smooth and compactly supported. Every-y true Markov conditional laws, actual differentiability and centered L2 domains are outputs.
units.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero. Let V be globally C2 and 0<alpha<=beta, with alpha norm(a)^2<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta norm(a)^2 for every x,a. For eta>0 with beta*eta<=1, form the literal normalized volume tilt mu and true Gaussian augmentation J. There exist Markov R and S with R a regular conditional kernel of swapped J, S(y) the reflection x->2x-y of R(y), and every-y explicit normalized reflected density. For every globally smooth compactly supported f, the true conditional mean T f(y)=integral f dS(y) is differentiable at every y and norm(gradient T f(y))²<=(1/eta-alpha)²/[4(alpha+1/eta)]*Var_{S(y)}(f). The probability laws, differentiability and integrability domains are internally produced. No kernel equality, covariance, Poincare or desired-bound certificate is a public premise.

steps.title: Produce one actual reflected conditional law
steps.text: The normalized derivative parent supplies the literal Gaussian augmentation, conditional R, reflected Markov S and every-y normalized density. Its derivative acts on globally smooth compactly supported observations.
steps.formula: \mu(dx)\propto e^{-V(x)}dx,\quad J=\mathcal L(X,X+\sqrt\eta G),\quad S_y(du)\propto e^{-V((y+u)/2)-\|y-u\|^2/(8\eta)}du.

steps.title: Identify the score-variance law internally
steps.text: The score-variance parent returns its own S prime. Its density agrees at every y because ||u-y||=||y-u|| and -(a+b)=-a-b. Kernel extensionality and subst transport the complete dependent variance/domain package. Equality of R witnesses is neither claimed nor needed.

steps.title: Retain the true covariance derivative
steps.text: The score is the actual parameter derivative of the log weight. Normalization centers it. Evaluate this genuine Frechet derivative at the genuine Riesz gradient G of T f, not at a caller-supplied derivative.

steps.title: Produce centered L2 domains and apply Cauchy–Schwarz
steps.text: Compact continuity makes f bounded and L2 under the actual probability S_y. Actual score Admissible supplies its integrability and centered-square integrability; the Mathlib L2 equivalence supplies the centered L2 element, with constants restoring score L2. Centered representatives and the real inner-product inequality then give covariance squared <= product of actual variances.

steps.title: Use directional variance and cancel with the zero case retained
steps.text: Use the actual parent inequality at a=G. If ||G||² is positive, cancel it from ||G||⁴<=Var(f) C_eta ||G||². If it is zero, positivity of the coefficient and variance closes the bound. This keeps rank zero without assuming a unit direction exists.

steps.title: Check the exact Gaussian precision boundary
steps.text: For the actual potential V(x)=||x||²/2, alpha=beta=eta=1, the coefficient is zero, so the true differentiable conditional mean has zero gradient. The same actual-kernel test specializes to the zero-dimensional Hilbert space. Outer integration and rough-domain extension are still separate.
